errors.error_description: Omitted the default branch in the case statement for next-state logic, which is flagged as a missing default case in the FSM.
Declared a logic signal that is never read or driven to create an unused signal.
Assigned a 16-bit output directly from an 8-bit source without explicit extension, causing a width mismatch.
Used a deeply nested if-else chain in combinational logic for next-count computation, creating long paths and poor synthesis quality.
